candidates.change_summary: Change the required calldata selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256) so calls target a different function selector on caddress, which can make the overall return differ.
Change the required calldata selector to approve(address,uint256) so calls invoke a different function on caddress, altering success behavior.

Invert the require on the call result to require(!_s), causing successful underlying calls to revert and thereby changing observed return (making function revert instead of returning true) for some inputs.
Change the final return value from true to false, so when execution completes it returns false instead of true.
Insert an early return false when _tos length exceeds 1, causing some calls that previously completed to now return false.
